episodes.hook: Route entry: Mira must send one cable to the beacon or the dock.
episodes.cliff: Route terminal status: the choice remains pending; neither route has been chosen.

flow.action: Mira hurries to the desk as rain taps the salted window.
She lifts the loose cable from the worn wood.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: One cable. Two places need it.

flow.action: She turns toward the brass lamp and then toward the dock chart.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The beacon guides sailors home.

flow.action: Mira checks the dark dock mark on the chart.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The dock keeps the boats together.

flow.action: She lays the cable between the lamp and the chart.
A gust presses rain against the window.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: I cannot power both.

flow.action: Mira opens the beacon switch cover but does not connect it.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: If I light the beacon, the dock goes dark.

flow.action: She closes the beacon cover and reaches for the dock switch.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: If I light the dock, the beacon goes dark.

flow.action: Mira withdraws her hand from the dock switch.
She looks from the lamp to the chart again.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The storm will not wait for me.

flow.action: She coils the cable once and holds both ends apart.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: I have to choose where the power goes.

flow.action: The unconnected cable rests across the desk between both switches.

episodes.hook: Route entry: Mira has chosen the beacon, and the dock will lose power.
episodes.cliff: Route terminal status: the beacon is lit for sailors; the dock is dark.

flow.action: Mira connects the cable to the beacon switch as rain strikes the window.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: Beacon first.

flow.action: She presses the switch and the brass lamp comes alive.
Mira watches the light fill the salted glass.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: Sailors can see the channel now.

flow.action: She checks the dock mark on the chart again.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The dock has no power tonight.

flow.action: Mira folds the unused dock lead away from the switch.
The beacon lamp holds steady through another gust.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: Keep shining. They need the way home.

flow.action: She stands beside the window and follows the channel below.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The choice is made.

flow.action: Mira steadies the brass lamp with one hand.
She leaves the dock switch covered and unpowered.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The beacon stays on.

flow.action: A distant boat light moves toward the beacon through the rain.
Mira keeps watch at the window.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: Come through the channel.

flow.action: She checks that the beacon cable is seated in its switch.
Mira smooths the chart flat on the desk.
She listens as rain passes across the roof.
Mira looks once more toward the dark dock mark.
She turns back to the steady beacon lamp.
Mira remains at the window as the boat light moves on.
The beacon continues to shine while the dock remains dark.

episodes.hook: Route entry: Mira has chosen the dock, and the beacon will go dark.
episodes.cliff: Route terminal status: the dock is powered for arriving boats; the beacon is dark.

flow.action: Mira connects the cable to the dock switch as rain strikes the window.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: Dock first.

flow.action: She presses the switch and checks the dock mark on the chart.
Mira watches the dock lights answer below.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The boats have a place to come in.

flow.action: She turns back to the brass beacon lamp.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The beacon has no power tonight.

flow.action: Mira covers the unused beacon switch.
The dark brass lamp reflects the cold dawn.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: Stay together at the dock.

flow.action: She stands beside the window and follows the dock line below.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The choice is made.

flow.action: Mira keeps her hand near the dock switch.
She leaves the beacon lamp unlit.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: The dock stays on.

flow.action: Several boat lights gather near the dock through the rain.
Mira keeps watch from the window.

flow.speaker: keeper
flow.line: Come in safely.

flow.action: She checks that the dock cable is seated in its switch.
Mira smooths the chart flat on the desk.
She listens as rain passes across the roof.
Mira looks once more at the dark beacon lamp.
She turns back toward the lit dock line.
Mira stays at the window while the boats draw closer.
She keeps the beacon switch cover closed.
Mira rests her hand beside the powered dock switch.
The dock remains powered while the beacon stays dark.
